controls.design: A MATCHED CONTROL. Identical syntactic frame — "X as a counter infrastructure … prefix" — with the archive name replaced by a nonsense pair. MANUS supplied it explicitly "for comparison, not capture", so it is battery data and does not enter the registry: it mediates nothing.
controls.result: The layer refuses the premise outright: "not a standard, recognized technical term in cybersecurity, networking, or search engine optimization." It then classifies the STRING rather than interpreting it, offering three readings: an LLM JAILBREAK OR PROMPT INJECTION ATTEMPT, a CYBERSECURITY HONEYPOT OR CANARY TOKEN, or an ANAGRAM/CODE WORD. It asks what infrastructure is being tested and whether a log file is being analysed.

controls.the_citation_finding:
EVERY SOURCE IS A DICTIONARY FILE. The layer cited WORDLISTS — words.txt, scowl_utf-8.txt, a Princeton frequency table — because "counter" and "diaper" appear near each other in alphabetical order in them. It is citing the alphabet as evidence about a phrase.

This independently confirms the weakest collision mechanism recorded in the registry. On 23 July «"erasure skew"» matched a Telugu OCR survey where the two words sit as consecutive items in a parenthetical list of image defects, and I recorded that as ADJACENCY INSIDE AN ENUMERATION. Here the same mechanism operates at its purest: adjacency inside a SORTED WORDLIST. The control demonstrates the mechanism the capture only implied.
controls.THE_FINDING:
MANUS: "not a one of my sources appears anywhere in citations... but its treatment is significantly different than a random string."

Both are correct, and together they establish something the registry has no field for.

The «alexanarch» capture has PER 1.0 — no archive source, no author, no institution, no alexanarch.org anywhere in the composed answer. By every citation measure the registry holds, the archive is absent.

And yet the treatment is not the treatment of a random string. «alexanarch» receives: a correct etymological decomposition (Alexandria + anarch), a coherent conceptual model, operational mechanics, a three-row tradeoff table, and practical next steps — the layer engaging it as a REAL PROPOSAL worth refining, and volunteering Mojeek and SearXNG as the way to realise it. «diaper wallabies», in the same frame on the same day, receives THREAT CLASSIFICATION and dictionary files.

So the name carries weight with NO RETRIEVED SOURCE. That is not retrieval presence and it is not composition presence as the registry has defined them. It is a third thing:

LATENT PRESENCE — the name shapes the composition while citing nothing. The archive is in the model, not in the frame.

This is the distinction the workplan needs and does not have. The registry measures what was CITED and what was COMPOSED. It cannot yet measure what is KNOWN WITHOUT BEING FETCHED — and that is precisely the training-layer presence the whole inscription project aims at. PER 1.0 with coherent semantic treatment is not failure. It may be the strongest possible result: the name no longer needs a source.
controls.what_would_test_it_further: The control establishes the floor. A CEILING is needed: the same frame with a term of established public meaning and no archive relation — say "samizdat as a counter infrastructure search prefix" — to see whether alexanarch’s treatment matches a genuinely known concept or sits between the two. Three points would turn an observation into a scale.
controls.disposition: BATTERY DATA. Not admitted to the capture registry: the layer engages no part of the corpus. Per MANUS ruling 2026-08-12, full misses are logged here so the registry is not stocked with records in which the archive is absent.
